research_mode: official live endpoints and official documentation only; no exact parcel join or safety score claimed

sources.name: Live crime-data last-updated endpoint
verified_claims: runtime requests must pin the corresponding YYYY-MM edition
limitations: the response confirms publication month only
it does not prove completeness or accuracy for any target parcel

sources.name: Live available street-data months endpoint
verified_claims: the endpoint provides month-specific contributing-force information for stop-and-search data
limitations: force lists in this response do not independently prove street-crime completeness
the exact target response still requires a pinned request and hash

sources.name: Live police-force identifier catalogue
verified_claims: official endpoint returns current force IDs and display names
returned IDs can be cross-checked against force-specific changelog entries and response metadata
limitations: force membership does not spatially bind a parcel to an LSOA
British Transport Police and territorial-force semantics must remain distinct

sources.name: Police.uk provenance anonymisation and data-quality specification
verified_claims: crime locations are replaced with anonymised map points
uploads undergo format validation automated testing and manual force approval
published geocoding accuracy estimates vary by force from 60 percent to 97 percent
limitations: published coordinates are not exact incident coordinates
quality assurance does not make every location or force-month complete

sources.name: Police API call-limit contract
verified_claims: current rate limit is 15 requests per second
limitations: parallel workers must remain below the sustained limit
retries require backoff and must not duplicate promoted rows

sources.name: Police API authentication contract
verified_claims: the official Police API no longer requires authentication
limitations: no-auth access does not remove rate limits response validation or provenance requirements

sources.name: Crimes with no location API contract
verified_claims: the official API exposes a separate route for crimes without a usable street location
limitations: point or polygon queries can omit non-locatable records
absence from a spatial response must not be interpreted as absence of crime

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: IoD25 frequently asked questions on ranks deciles and scores
verified_claims: rank 1 is most deprived and rank 33755 is least deprived
official deciles divide the ranked LSOA universe into ten groups
ranks are based on unrounded scores
limitations: Crime Domain scores are not population proportions or safety probabilities
rank differences are ordinal and must not be read as proportional risk differences

sources.publisher: Office for National Statistics Open Geography Portal
sources.name: Open Geography Portal Search API definition
verified_claims: the official Search API supports programmatic catalogue query filtering and search
limitations: catalogue discovery does not prove target-point containment
the selected boundary item URL edition schema and response hash must still be recorded
